content.value: A trapezoidal channel having bottom width 5 m and 1:1 side slope carries a 17 discharge of 12.2 m³/sec. Compute the critical depth and the critical velocity. If Manning's n = 0.2, determine the bottom slope required to maintain the critical depth.
